headline: Hedge Fund Arini Sells $800 Million in Debt Amid Losses, WSJ Reports
summary: Alternative credit manager Arini has sold $800 million in debt positions as losses mount, according to The Wall Street Journal.
why: Arini is a prominent European credit hedge fund specializing in leveraged finance, structured credit, and distressed debt markets.

impacts.name: Arini
impacts.why: The firm offloaded $800 million of debt holdings to curb accumulating fund losses.
